Players Committee card image of [[Velken Tezeri (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Smuggler. While present at a pit, adds 1 to your Force drains here. Unless 'hit' (or Gamall Wironicc here), your other characters here may not be targeted by lightsabers. May not target Luke with weapons.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/velkentezeri.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
